title: Buchanan remote views alien mining bases on the Moon
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Buchanan remote views alien mining bases on the Moon, about unspecified at The Moon, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Basically, what I got for most of them was minerals.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who did remote viewing, meaning trying to see faraway places using only the mind, says he was asked to look at what he describes as alien bases on the Moon. He says that for most of them, what he picked up was minerals, which he takes to mean they were mining sites, and that would mean someone other than us is working the Moon.
